title: NFL has "no concern" about Joe Buck/Troy Aikman booth issues

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL has "no concern" about Joe Buck/Troy Aikman booth issues
sources.description: The unexpected emergence of reported tension between Joe Buck and Troy Aikman, coupled with multiple comments from Aikman regarding his dismay over the lack of contract talks with ESPN/ABC on an extension, has prompted much discussion (and careful scrutiny) as to the dynamics between the men who call Monday Night Football.
